coverage.name: Hinsdale County
limitations: No Hinsdale County ballot issue or question appears on the posted styles (STATE, 001-01, 001-02, 001-03, PO-USJHS).

Excluded (not housing): Archuleta County School District No. 50JT Ballot Issue 5A (school construction bond) and Upper San Juan Health Service District Ballot Issue 7B (revenue retention "WITHOUT RAISING TAXES").
A joint Town/County work-session packet discussed a possible 2-mill housing levy "if November 2026 pursued"; no referring resolution was found and no such question is on the posted sample ballots.

The sample ballot PDF is a scan of Silver World newspaper pages (2026-09-18) with the ballots as embedded images; it was read visually, not by text extraction. The scanned back of style 001-01 ends at the second column.
No TABOR notice and no list of participating political subdivisions was posted as of 2026-09-26.

coverage.name: Lake City (town)
limitations: Excluded (governance): Town of Lake City Ballot Question 2A (moves the regular municipal election from April to November of even-numbered years; Resolution 2026-08) and Ballot Question 2B (reduces trustees from six to four; Resolution 2026-09). Both appear under Municipal Ballot Measures on style 001-02.

The sample ballot PDF is a scan of Silver World newspaper pages (2026-09-18) with the ballots as embedded images; it was read visually, not by text extraction. The scanned back of style 001-01 ends at the second column.
